description: This file defines a PHP class 'BlogSubController' within the Goteo project, specifically in the admin module. The class handles various administrative actions related to blog posts, such as listing, editing, adding, removing, reordering posts, and managing their placement in different sections like homepage, footer, and portal. It extends an abstract controller, implements permission checks, processes form submissions, and interacts with models like 'Blog' and 'Post'.

classes.name: Goteo\Controller\Admin\BlogSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing blog posts within the admin panel of Goteo. Includes methods for listing, editing, adding, deleting, and positioning blog entries, as well as permission checks and handling form submissions.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to perform actions in this controller based on their role within a node.

methods.name: reorderAction
methods.description: Handles reordering of blog posts for homepage placement.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles translation-related actions for blog posts.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Manages the process of editing an existing blog post or preparing a form for editing.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Prepares the form for adding a new blog post.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a post up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a post down in order.

methods.name: add_homeAction
methods.description: Adds a post to the homepage.

methods.name: remove_homeAction
methods.description: Removes a post from the homepage.

methods.name: footerAction
methods.description: Lists posts in the footer section.

methods.name: up_footerAction
methods.description: Moves a footer post up in order.

methods.name: down_footerAction
methods.description: Moves a footer post down in order.

methods.name: add_footerAction
methods.description: Adds a post to the footer.

methods.name: remove_footerAction
methods.description: Removes a post from the footer.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists blog posts based on filters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main handler for multiple blog actions: listing, adding, editing, deleting, reordering, and placement adjustments.
